title: Olu Fashanu knows where experienced Jets offensive line’s focus must be with Geno Smith at QB

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Olu Fashanu knows where experienced Jets offensive line’s focus must be with Geno Smith at QB
sources.description: So much change can affect a young offensive lineman, but Olu Fashanu is looking forward to working in an offensive line that returns four of its starters from 2025.
